title: Nucleic Acid Purification with Magnetic Beads
author: Opentrons
materials: With this protocol, you can perform high-quality nucleic acid purifications using magnetic beads and the [Opentrons Magnetic Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/magdeck]). This protocol contains flexible parameters that you can customize for many different magnetic bead and nucleic acid types. Use this setup to rapidly iterate and optimize your magbead-based workflows! You can use any magnetic beads you prefer with this protocol, but we have included some reagent recommendations in the **Materials Needed** section below to help you get started. For more detailed information on how to use this protocol, please see our [Technical Note](https://s3.amazonaws.com/opentrons-protocol-library-website/Technical+Notes/Nucleic+Acid+Purification+with+Magnetic+Module+OT2+Technical+Note.pdf). --- --- -- [Opentrons OT-2](http://opentrons.com/ot-2) -- [Opentrons Magnetic Module](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/magdeck?_ga=2.171718441.823190023.1542396855-403439593.1535387376) -- [Opentrons OT-2 Run App (Version 3.1.2 or later)](http://opentrons.com/ot-app) -- 200uL or 300 uL Tiprack ([Opentrons tips suggested](https://shop.opentrons.com/collections/opentrons-tips/products/opentrons-300ul-tips-racks-9-600-tips)) -- [12-row automation-friendly trough](https://www.usascientific.com/12-channel-automation-reservoir.aspx) -- [BioRad HardShell 96-Well PCR Plate](http://www.bio-rad.com/en-us/sku/hsp9601-hard-shell-96-well-pcr-plates-low-profile-thin-wall-skirted-white-clear?ID=hsp9601) -- Magnetic Beads (Looking for a kit? We recommend trying [Omega Bio-tek Mag-Bind® TotalPure NGS](https://shop.opentrons.com/products/mag-bind-total-pure-ngs)) -- Ethanol -- Elution Buffer (Typically 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, TE Buffer, or nuclease-free water) --- --- Using the customization fields below, set up your protocol as follows: * **Pipette:** Specify your pipette. We recommend using a p50 or p300 multi- or single-channel. * **Pipette Mount:** Specify which mount (left or right) your pipette is
Make sure to add reagents to your labware before placing it on the deck! You can see where to place your reagents below.

steps.title: Gather required materials
steps.instruction: Collect all items listed: Opentrons OT‑2, Opentrons Magnetic Module, Opentrons OT‑2 Run App (Version 3.1.2 or later), 200 µL or 300 µL tiprack (Opentrons tips suggested), 12‑row automation‑friendly trough, BioRad HardShell 96‑Well PCR Plate, magnetic beads (e.g., Omega Bio‑tek Mag‑Bind® TotalPure NGS), ethanol, and elution buffer (typically 10 mM Tris pH 8.0, TE buffer, or nuclease‑free water).

steps.title: Configure protocol customization
steps.instruction: In the customization fields, specify the pipette (p50 or p300, multi‑ or single‑channel) and the pipette mount (left or right) for the run.

steps.title: Select desired setup settings
steps.instruction: Choose all desired settings according to the "Setup" section to create your customized protocol.

steps.title: Download customized protocol
steps.instruction: Click the blue "Download" button to obtain the customized Nucleic Acid Purification protocol file.

steps.title: Upload protocol to Opentrons
steps.instruction: Load the downloaded protocol file into the Opentrons Run App, follow the on‑screen instructions to set up the deck layout, and start the run.

substeps.instruction: Open the Run App (Version 3.1.2 or later).
Arrange labware on the virtual deck as indicated.

steps.title: Add reagents to labware
steps.instruction: Place all reagents (magnetic beads, ethanol, elution buffer, etc.) into the appropriate labware (e.g., trough, 96‑well PCR plate) before positioning the deck on the robot.

substeps.instruction: Ensure magnetic beads are in the designated reservoir.
Add ethanol to its assigned well.
Add elution buffer (10 mM Tris pH 8.0, TE buffer, or nuclease‑free water) to the appropriate location.
Verify reagent placement matches the deck map.
